questions: Does the CLI have a resume command for goals?

answers.answer: No. The goals subcommands (src/goals/index.ts:8-14) are create, list, get, and terminate. No resume case exists in the switch statement. The terminate.ts command is the closest pattern for implementing resume.

statement: The CLI needs a new 'hlx goals resume <goalId>' command. It follows the terminate.ts pattern: parse goalId from args, POST to /api/goals/:id/resume with empty body, display result. The goals/index.ts switch statement needs a new 'resume' case, and cli-content.ts docs need updating.
